item.title: Critical Infrastructure Cyber Attack Tracker
item.description:
Critical Infrastructure Cyber Attack Tracker

Overview

This project is a Cyber Threat Intelligence tracker focused on cyber campaigns targeting critical infrastructure across Central and Eastern Europe.

The objective is to collect, structure and analyze publicly available intelligence related to cyber attacks, threat actors and information operations.

Geographic Scope

Currently tracking activity related to:

  • Poland
  • Ukraine
  • Lithuania
  • Latvia
  • Estonia
  • Romania

Research Focus

The tracker analyzes:

  • cyber attack campaigns
  • threat actors
  • attack motivation
  • attack techniques
  • targeted industries
  • targeted organizations
  • campaign timelines
  • associated narratives
  • collected artifacts

item.title: About
item.description:
About Me

I am a Cyber Threat Intelligence researcher focused on understanding cyber threats, adversary behavior and emerging attack campaigns.

My work combines threat intelligence, OSINT research and security analysis to transform publicly available information into actionable insights.

Areas of Focus

Cyber Threat Intelligence

Researching threat actors, cyber campaigns and evolving threat landscapes.

OSINT Investigations

Collecting, validating and analyzing information from open sources to identify connections, infrastructure and adversary activity.
